It is based on high-speed text parsing, and does not involve any kind of intermediate representation of the JSON (the only thing passed between functions are JSON text strings). \0A\0ASupports searching for elements in the JSON using JSON Path notation (example '$.Users[*].Name'). \0A\0AExtensive support for converting to/from LabVIEW types. Can use tag in cluster element names to identify strings that should retain JSON format. \0A\0AAllows formating JSON using "Pretty Print".\0A\0AAs extension to standard JSON, will allow Comments. \0A\0ANote: On Windows 10, it may be necessary to run VI Package Manager "as an administrator" in order to install the VI Package."
